reason: I would try the free part, but I would not pay every month. Throwing out vegetables hurts, but $3.99 a month is about $48 a year and I can write a list and check the fridge myself for free.
objection: Another subscription for things I can already do. The part that saves me money, scanning receipts, is locked behind the paid plan, so I pay before I know it works.
would_change_my_mind: A free month of Remi Plus with no card needed, so I could see whether it really stops me wasting vegetables, or a one-time price instead of a subscription.
